source_tests: legacy script has no testthat expectations
reason: att_gt_point_estimate_tests.R is a legacy executable script with printed results and comments rather than formal testthat expectations. The Stata port can map the public point-estimate scenarios but cannot reproduce non-asserted console output as a unit-test oracle.
accepted_behavior: Stata verifies the public panel, two-period, no-covariate, repeated-cross-section, allow_unbalanced, and not-yet-treated point-estimate scenarios through executable assertions.
